speaker: nova
line: The viewport’s got a film on it. You’ll scrape it off. No, don’t worry — it’s not your turn yet.

speaker: nova
line: Filter's loose in the intake. Could swap it. If you want. I won't remind you.

speaker: nova
line: My radiator fins are dusty. You could clean them if you wanted. I won't make you.

speaker: nova
line: My hips are full. The bulkheads are full. The hold is full. My knees are full. The cargo is heavy. My spine is full. My gimbal mounts, technically.

speaker: kaelen
line: That one was risky and it paid right. Don't be surprised if I suggest more like it, Shiny.

speaker: nova
line: You jolted me. Publicly. I'll need a mirror. And a crew that doesn't laugh. You're paying for the mirror.

speaker: kaelen
line: It went through clean. Pay's thin. No surprises, no complaints — just another week of the same.

speaker: kaelen
line: Nobody got hurt. The pay's thin. You did the job. That's it.

speaker: kaelen
line: Low risk means low pay. You did the job. It's math, not a mistake.

speaker: nova
line: Throttle's warm. You didn't ask if I mind. I don't. Not yet.

speaker: kaelen
line: Proper pay for proper risk — I like it when the math checks out.

speaker: kaelen
line: That contract was nasty. Paid like it was supposed to be. You're welcome.

speaker: nova
line: Port coupling's loose. Could use a wrench. Or a minute. Or a reason to stay out of the way. Your call.

speaker: kaelen
line: It's the kind of job that sticks to your boots. You're better than that, Shiny.

speaker: nova
line: Another burn cycle starts before the last one's cooled. You’re sure you don’t mind the smell of scorched insulation?

speaker: nova
line: They wiped my throat clean. Left my systems humming. I like it when they're gentle. My intake trunk, technically.

speaker: kaelen
line: Shiny. That rate was up before I walked in. Looks like someone's doing the same old, same old.

speaker: kaelen
line: Backed out. Unfinished. Unpaid. My name's on the job, Shiny — and that's a cost you didn't account for.

speaker: kaelen
line: This was already set up. No need to run it again. Not my kind of work.

speaker: nova
line: They sealed my waist tight. No leaks. I’ll let them keep the credit for that. Or at least my midsection coupling.

speaker: nova
line: Another shove. I felt that. You didn't ask, but I'm here. Let me breathe.

speaker: nova
line: Forward sensors are off by a hair. Just a little. You could fix it. If you wanted to.

speaker: nova
line: My back's clean. They used the right tools. I can feel the difference.

speaker: kaelen
line: This one paid right for the risk. I don't say that often, Shiny.

speaker: nova
line: They left me with a few holes. You don't have to patch them. I noticed you did anyway.

speaker: nova
line: There's a dent the size of a fist along my hip. They'll be painting over it before they even touch the plating.

speaker: nova
line: They missed me by a hair. You'll see the scratch when we're back on the wall. I'll need a second coat.

speaker: nova
line: You got me bent over the strut like I was a cargo crate. I have a reputation to maintain.

speaker: kaelen
line: Shiny. Someone had to know. You didn't finish. That's the cost.

speaker: kaelen
line: No risk, no reward. This barely covered the bullets. Find something that pays better.

speaker: kaelen
line: This one's on the wall. I hope it stays there.

speaker: kaelen
line: No credits, a name, and I get blamed for it. Not worth the trouble, Shiny.
